description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithEmployeeString' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. The class provides a method to return a fixed string 'Employee' regardless of the input. The file is part of the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system, specifically within the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin' plugin's 'PurgeStrategy/FormatValue' directory.
